title: Expose the expert's local feedback map instead of isolated labels
hypothesis: Local expert action sensitivities reveal corrective feedback that isolated state-action labels obscure, allowing gait-preserving symbolic residuals to improve retention.

prediction.rationale: Baseline receives raw expert labels at the same learner-visited states; treatment additionally represents local feedback sensitivities within the same evidence-token budget. Compare final promoted incumbents on fresh sustained success, using a paired t interval over six block means. Unlike R-046, both arms preserve the gait, so the contrast tests feedback-map information rather than preservation.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study local_feedback_evidence --block-seeds 4210,4211,4212,4213,4214,4215 --output-dir logs/pen_spin_local_feedback_evidence"'
code_changes: scripts/run_full_evolution.py: add the declared local_feedback_evidence study CLI and freeze six disjoint block manifest suites before generation; use the frozen scripted gait as the common parent, bc_steps=0, and identical bounded-residual enforcement in both arms.

scripts/run_full_evolution.py: obtain 32 states from two parent screen trajectories selected by a fixed failure-first rule; query the qualified expert at those states and use symmetric finite differences in pen-centre, axial-rate, and finger-flexion coordinates to summarize local action sensitivities without extra simulator rollouts.

scripts/run_full_evolution.py: bound perturbations using frozen expert-demonstration ranges, log query distances and saturation, and describe sensitivities as model responses rather than verified recovery actions.

config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: define raw-label and sensitivity-evidence arms with equal token budgets and two candidate slots each; use gpt-6.1-sol, reasoning_effort high, temperature 1, and at most one linked correction per slot.

config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml: allocate per block 80 parent episodes and 90 episodes per arm: two candidates screened on 10 cases each, one selected candidate on 10 disjoint probe cases, 30 promotion cases, and 30 untouched fresh cases; promote only against the parent under the existing strict paired rule.

scripts/run_full_evolution.py: run this content diagnostic ungated in every block because D-041 lacked enough eligible plateaus; retain the production plateau trigger unchanged and make no claim about its efficacy.

falsified_by: An upper paired interval bound below +0.15 refutes the predicted gain; an interval spanning +0.15 is inconclusive, and tied success is not improvement.

direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: This isolates feedback-map evidence while holding gait preservation fixed, addressing a question D-041 did not settle. Running ungated avoids repeating D-041's insufficient-eligibility failure without changing the production plateau trigger. The 1560 simulator episodes and at most 72 LLM calls are justified by the paired content comparison; the main limitation is that finite-difference model responses need not describe physically effective recovery actions, which the protocol explicitly retains. An upper interval bound below +0.15 falsifies the predicted paired_success_difference increase of at least 0.15 against raw-label evidence, and an interval containing zero cannot establish improvement.

implementer.reasoning: Agreed: ungated blocks avoid D-041's eligibility failure, and holding gait preservation fixed in both arms isolates evidence content. R-046 block 1 showed the bounded residual tracks the gait (0.467 vs 0.433), so the gait base rate gives room in both directions. I will compute finite differences on the PPO expert's observation inputs (no simulator rollouts), bounded by demonstration ranges, and label them model responses.
